_comment: P15-49 (gap 209) run configuration, written by P15-52 (gap 212, E2 part). It encodes plan.md (29c1dc9) and changes no arm, user, rule, window, seed, grid or stop rule. Keys whose name ends in '_choice' are not fixed by plan.md; they were chosen here before any run (see README.md, 'Choices not fixed by the plan'). Output folder: derived/p15-49 (the task brief names this folder; plan.md says derived/e2-t15 - a path change only).

base.recipe: experiments/2026-11-15-m4-13-long-train/train.py + t15.py, imported unchanged (model 768 x 5 GRU, L 0, 45 day layers)
base._run_name_note: train.py asserts that the run folder name starts with 'm4-13-'; the folder is <out>/base/<run_name>
base.selection: last step (latest.pt at step 30,000), no selection

start_guard_choice.calibrate_on: all labelled S8 items, base decoder (S8 day layer = copy of the S7 day layer)
start_guard_choice.aci_lam_init: commit_p of the start guard (if finite, else the ACI default)
start_guard_choice.candidate_guard: every proposal (decoder or re-calibration) uses a copy of the start guard as the candidate; the loop raises commit_p to the session threshold on accept

word_route: P14-03 / P15-05 T15 route: experiments/2026-11-17-trust-reruns-m4-13/common.py word_decoder() + experiments/2026-11-16-p14-03-replay-validation/run.py make_decode_fn(), read only (B2T '25 phoneme beam + CMUdict lexicon + Tatoeba LMs, lm 1.0 / edit 12 / bonus 3)

fit.optimiser_choice: AdamW (torch defaults: betas 0.9 / 0.999, eps 1e-8), constant LR, a new optimiser per fit; weight decay by the M4-13 parameter groups (weights 0.001, biases 0, day layers 0); gradient clip 10 (M4-13)
fit.nightly_lr_choice: the chosen update-1 LR (plan.md names one LR grid only)
fit.nightly_labels_choice: the arm's labels of the replay sessions S9 .. d (all phases); no base-session labels
fit.augmentation: M4-13 collate (white noise 1.0, offset 0.2, random cut 3 bins), input dropout 0.2 and dropout 0.4 (patch_model), micro_chunks

grid.rule: lowest S8 phase-C WER of the live output; ties: smaller LR, then fewer steps
grid.nightly_note: the nightly fit comes after phase C, so it cannot change the S8 phase-C WER: each LR runs once and its result is the result of both step cells (exact tie, so the rule picks 150 steps)

cap_check: before each part (base, grid, every replay run); a started run finishes. Clock = wall time of the job (it blocks the GPU while it runs)

checkpoint.replay: after every session (one session is about 3-15 min)

stage2_t12: not wired by this wrapper (plan.md: it starts only after the T15 U1 runs finish, if the cap leaves >= 8 h)
